summary: Security review hardened username validation by rejecting non-ASCII confusable identifiers; JWT, password storage, and user-scoped authorization checks otherwise passed review.
decisions: Restricted usernames to ASCII letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens because SQLite NOCASE is ASCII-oriented and Unicode lookalikes could create visually confusable distinct accounts.
Added a regression test for a Cyrillic-lookalike username; all 5 tests pass.
